caption:
SPINACH + CHERRY TOMATO SCRAMBLED EGGS 🍳🍅

My kind of lazy-girl breakfast — eggs, garlicky cherry tomatoes, wilted spinach and a little seasoning. Takes about 10 minutes and actually keeps you full.

Macros: ~300 kcal | ~20g protein
Serves: 1

Ingredients

* 3 eggs
* 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
* 1 packed cup spinach
* 2–3 garlic cloves, finely chopped
* 1 tsp olive oil
* Salt, to taste
* Black pepper, to taste
* ½ tsp chilli flakes
* ¼ tsp oregano
* 1 tbsp milk/water (optional, for softer eggs)

Method

1. Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté the garlic for 20–30 seconds.
2. Add cherry tomatoes, salt, pepper and chilli flakes. Cook until the tomatoes soften and start getting a little jammy.
3. Add spinach and cook until wilted.
4. Beat the eggs with a splash of milk/water and pour them in.
5. Keep the heat low and gently fold the eggs until just cooked and still soft.
6. Finish with oregano, black pepper and chilli flakes.

PRO TIP: Don’t overcook the eggs. Take them off the heat when they still look slightly underdone — they’ll finish cooking from the residual heat.

Save this for the next time you want a 10-minute breakfast that doesn’t taste like diet food. 🫶🏻
